items.title: Residential proximity to oil and gas development and socioeconomic conditions: a comparative analysis of 33 countries
items.title_en: Residential proximity to oil and gas development and socioeconomic conditions: a comparative analysis of 33 countries
items.title_zh: 居民区与油气开发项目的邻近程度及社会经济状况：对33个国家的比较分析
items.summary_en: Fossil fuels continue to dominate the global energy supply. As emerging technologies drive up global energy consumption (e.g. cryptocurrency mining, data centers), identifying which populations live in residential proximity to oil and gas extraction will become increasingly important. Yet, no prior study has done so on an international scale. We combine the Oil and Gas Infrastructure Mapping database with the Global Human Settlement Layer to estimate residential proximity to oil and gas wells across 33 countries in 2024. We further link these data with indicators of income and social deprivation to examine disparities in population proximity. We estimate that 150.9 million people reside within 3 km of 4.5 million oil and gas wells across 33 countries, representing 10% of their population. Country-level residential proximity to oil and gas wells is highest in the Netherlands (38.4%), Canada (33.4%), and the United States (31.3%). Of the 33 countries, 15 had populations exposed to wells across borders, including 427 thousand Mexican residents near U.S. wells, and 185 thousand U.S. residents living near wells outside national borders. This is the first large-scale, multi-country quantification of residential exposure to oil and gas extraction, providing an evidence base for future population health research and policies to reduce risks and address energy-related inequities worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 化石燃料继续主导着全球能源供应。随着新兴技术（如加密货币挖矿、数据中心）推动全球能源消耗上升，确定哪些人群居住在石油和天然气开采区附近将变得越来越重要。然而，此前尚无研究在国际范围内开展过此类工作。 我们结合“油气基础设施测绘”数据库与“全球人类聚居层”数据，估算了2024年33个国家居民居住地与油气井的距离。 我们进一步将这些数据与收入和社会剥夺指标相结合，以考察人口居住地与油气井距离方面的差异。据估算，在这33个国家中，有1.509亿人居住在450万口油气井3公里范围内，占这些国家总人口的10%。 从国家层面看，居民与油气井的距离最近的国家依次是荷兰（38.4%）、加拿大（33.4%）和美国（31.3%）。 在这33个国家中，有15个国家的居民因跨国油气井而受到影响，其中包括42.7万名居住在美国油气井附近的墨西哥居民，以及18.5万名居住在境外油气井附近的美国居民。 这是首次针对石油和天然气开采导致的居民暴露风险进行的大规模、多国量化研究，为未来的人口健康研究以及旨在降低风险、解决全球能源相关不平等问题的政策提供了证据基础。

items.title_zh: 青藏高原东南部与东北部夏季极端小时降水驱动因素的对比
items.summary_en: Extreme hourly precipitation (EHP) across the Tibetan Plateau (TP) often triggers flash floods and landslides due to the region’s complex and steep terrain, yet its inter-station covariations and formation mechanisms remain inadequately understood. Using climate network analysis of hourly station data and dynamic diagnostics, this study examines EHP synchronicity across the southeastern and northeastern TP and elucidates the underlying mechanisms from a perspective of sea surface temperature (SST)-forced circulation evolution. Results show weak inter-regional synchronization of EHP occurrence between the southeastern and northeastern TP, along with an insignificant correlation in EHP frequency (EHPF) between the two subregions, indicating largely independent governing physical processes. The southeastern TP EHPF is controlled by an upper-tropospheric South Asian anticyclone and a low-level anticyclone over the Arabian Sea. The South Asian anticyclone weakens after 2000, accompanied by intensified cyclonic circulation over the northern TP. In contrast, the northeastern TP EHPF is dominated by a quasi-barotropic Northeast Asian anticyclone throughout the entire period. SST drivers of EHPF over these two subregions exhibit both regional differences and interdecadal shifts. During 1979–1999, southeastern TP EHPF is linked to an eastern North Atlantic tripole (NAT) SST anomaly pattern through a teleconnection wave train, whereas northeastern TP EHPF correlates with a western NAT configuration. After 2000, Eurasian Arctic SST anomalies emerge as dominant signals—a dipole pattern for the southeastern TP and a uniform warming pattern for the northeastern TP. These results underscore the need for region-specific EHP analysis and prediction strategies and highlight the growing role of the Arctic.
items.summary_zh: 由于青藏高原（TP）地形复杂且陡峭，该地区的小时极端降水（EHP）常引发山洪和山体滑坡，但其站点间的共变关系及形成机制尚不十分清楚。 本研究利用对每小时观测站数据的气候网络分析及动力诊断方法，考察了青藏高原东南部与东北部地区极端小时降水（EHP）的同步性，并从海表温度（SST）驱动的环流演变角度阐明了其内在机制。 结果表明，青藏高原东南部与东北部之间极端小时降水发生存在较弱的区域间同步性，且这两个子区域之间的极端小时降水频率（EHPF）相关性不显著，这表明其主导的物理过程在很大程度上是独立的。 青藏高原东南部的EHPF受对流层上层的南亚高气压和阿拉伯海低层高气压控制。2000年后，南亚高气压减弱，同时青藏高原北部的气旋性环流增强。 相比之下，整个研究期间，青藏高原东北部的EHPF主要受东北亚准等压反气旋控制。这两个子区域EHPF的海表温度驱动因子既存在区域差异，也呈现出十年际变化。 1979–1999年间，青藏高原东南部的EHPF通过遥相关波列与东北海大西洋三极（NAT）海表温度异常模式相关联，而青藏高原东北部的EHPF则与东北海大西洋西部的配置相关。 2000年后，欧亚北极海表温度异常成为主导信号——青藏高原东南部的信号呈现双极模式，而东北部的信号则呈现均匀变暖模式。这些结果强调了制定针对不同区域的EHP分析和预测策略的必要性，并突显了北极日益重要的作用。

items.title_en: Hurricane warning maps are improving, but a dangerous problem remains
items.title_zh: 飓风预警图虽在不断改进，但一个危险的问题依然存在
items.summary_en: A new study reveals that improved hurricane forecast graphics may help people identify threatened areas without making them more likely to recognize the danger or take protective action. Researchers also found that a widespread misunderstanding of the hurricane cone persists, highlighting a potentially dangerous gap between accurate forecasts and public preparedness.
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究表明，改进后的飓风预报图虽然有助于人们识别受威胁区域，但未必能提高他们对危险的认知或促使他们采取防护措施。研究人员还发现，人们对飓风锥的普遍误解依然存在，这凸显了准确预报与公众防灾准备之间存在潜在的危险差距。
